text_block_list.text:
It was finally the day of the Yasuda 
Kinen, where Maruzensky and Grass Wonder 
would clash—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally. Grass-chan may be a cute 
junior, but her skill is anything but 
cute—it's phenomenal."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, but having an opponent like that 
is what makes racing fun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll run with joy and bring back a 
win!
